answer: A concrete rule the ledger can enforce: cap per-account emission and put the surplus into a pool earned only by non-duplicate work, because lantern only stays cheap while duplicating content caps out because the pool rewards novelty, not volume. Concretely, summit is enforced in the ledger: Nothing here needs to be perfect; it only has to make clones cost more than they return. Any echo approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
